svg.title: Synthetic example · One request under review
svg.desc: Synthetic path from an external source through a workload and principal to a specified target. The first two relationships are marked Not verified. Only the target-read relationship is interrupted and marked Blocked under checked conditions. These are editorial descriptions of evidence, not Tracegate interface states.
